bestBets.overview: DARK FAE is ready to break her maiden tag. She has been close up when placed at her last two starts and if she gets right run she looks the one to beat. OKAY ZOOMER is another that is racing in consistent form. Beaten less than a length when beaten by British Gem here last start. That form good for this. PRAGUE PRIDE was oin the market here last start but disappointed. Placed in two Victorian runs prior and would expect improvement while MOONYA LAD only just missed here last start. Chance to go one better.

raceTips.comment: Racing at Townsville on Tuesday on a track rated good or if not, very close to it. I’ll lean to Dark Fae in this opening race, consistent & drops back in distance which looks quite suitable. Drawn favourably should settle close enough to strike in the straight. Moonya Lad also holds a good record, fitter second up just an awkward draw to deal with. Okay Zoomer next best.

bestBets.overview: SMART LEGEND battled on well when just missed at Mackay two starts back then was not disgraced here last start. If he can produce his best form he can get away with this. JOURNALISM won a couple in a row then just left run too late from the back in the Townsville Cup last start. Drawn perfectly and he can win this. THE PENSKE FILE raced on the speed and only peaked late in the Cup. He can lead these and win while PRINCE AKEEM was poor last start but he was racing well prior and would not leave out of exotics.

raceTips.comment: Plenty of weight for Journalism however he should be too good for these. Fourth in the Rocky Cup, he then won the Mackay Cup & not far away in the Cup here last time out. Smart Legend comes through similar races, looms as the danger should there be one. Prince Akeem best of the rest.

bestBets.overview: RED HOT LIZZIE powered home from the back when grabbing an eye-catching placing here last start. She can sit a bit closer from her inside gate and with luck from the corner will take olding out. LEAN EAGLE was beaten less than 2 lengths at Cairns two starts back then again competitive last start. He can sneak a place. SPIRIT MEISTER jumped to the front and led all the way at Cairns last start. May try similar tactics in this while HELLISH has been disappointing of late but not much pace to worry about here and would not dismiss.

raceTips.comment: Drawn the pole gate in a small field Red Hot Lizzie shouldn't be giving away too big a start here. She's raced consistently over the carnival winning at Mackay the feature, looks a very suitable race for her. Lean Eagle brings a good form line through Tambo's Justice & should prove the main threat.

bestBets.overview: FARAWAY DOWNS found the class in the Guineas a little too hot here last start, but he had been placed in two runs prior and this looks a winnable race for him. JUST A DUCHESS comes into this ready to win. Chased home the smart Alberta Bound here last start and that form looks good for this. BETTERLUCKNEXTTIME won here two starts back before battling in better race last start. He can bounce back in this field while SUPID DATE is ready to find best third-up from spell. Just battled late last start but she is a must for first four players.

raceTips.comment: Faraway Downs found the mile too far in a feature race here on Cup Day & looks very well placed to bounce back hard. Prior runs were solid in good company & the drop back to 1400m is far more suitable. He rises nothing in weight which is a bonus. Betterlucknexttime raced wide in the Cleveland Bay, winner prior, another who will appreciate the drop back in class. Not a great deal amongst the remainder.

bestBets.overview: Might have something each-way on LOOMING ONE in this. He was placed here two starts back then beaten less than 2 lengths at Cairns last start. Drawn ideally and he takes beating. BRITISH GEM powered home from the back to win maiden this track last start. No reason she cannot make it two in a row in Queensland. ABATED BREATH has been working through his classes with authority winning last couple. This harde but must respect winning form while VOUCHERS was poor here last start but he has shown his best is good enough for a race like this.

raceTips.comment: Airwaves can bounce back off an unplaced run in a much stronger race here on Cup Day won by the flying Illegal Justice. Previous effort was a placing & a good one in a much stronger field than he faces this afternoon. Significant weight rise however draws the pole which should help gain a soft run. British Gem may have only broken through in maiden grade here last start however that was her first run since joining the new stable, wouldn't be the least surprised to see her measure up here.

bestBets.overview: Forget ECLIPSION went around last start when beaten favourite. Never out of trouble and took up plenty of the Stewards report for the race. He had won at Mackay prior and can return to winners stall. INTRUDER is never far away in his races. Beaten less than 2 lengths here last start and this looks no harder. BLUEBIRD BAY has been bit costly for punters of late having been beaten favourite in last couple, but he has drawn well and would not leave out while LONE FORCE charged hgome late when just missed here last start. He is a must for exotics.

raceTips.comment: Locally trained Lone Force was having his first run for a month here last start when beating all bar the winner going down by only a half-length. Fitter, he rises basically nothing in weight & draws to gain a good run in the race. Big weight for Medal however he's up to it & recent form certainly good enough for a race of this calibre. Bluebird Bay a chance, races on speed & drawn to do that economically.

bestBets.overview: BRIGINSHAW looks an up and coming gelding. Won maiden here two starts back then made some good late ground when placed last start. Drawn to get the perfect run in tansit and he can get away with this. DALT JAZ was strong winner two starts back then beaten less than a length here last start. Barrier a concern but must consider. FABULEAN resumes from spell. She has been placed fresh and must respect in this field. BANG STICK is another first-up. He has been placed in two of three fresh and cannot dismiss.

raceTips.comment: Right down the bottom I'm with Briginshaw who is only lightly raced & showing plenty of upside. He won his maiden here comfortably in June, scored in a trial 7 weeks late & then ran a good third here in a weaker race. Fitter & down in the weights he can run well from that pole gate. Get the feeling Time To Prophet can improve sharply whilst Fabulean rates a chance fresh, betting?
